title: trait bound error when nesting Reflect types in a HashMap inside another Reflect type

labels.name: S-Nominated-To-Close
labels.description: A triage team member thinks this PR or issue should be closed out.

body:
Having a HashMap with a Reflect type as the key inside another Reflect type produces this error:

```
error[E0277]: the trait bound `std::collections::HashMap<Thing, u32>: bevy::prelude::Reflect` is not satisfied
 --> examples/hello_world.rs:9:19
  |
9 | #[derive(Default, Reflect)]
  |                   ^^^^^^^ the trait `bevy::prelude::Reflect` is not implemented for `std::collections::HashMap<Thing, u32>`
  |
  = help: the following implementations were found:
            <std::collections::HashMap<K, V, ahash::random_state::RandomState> as bevy::prelude::Reflect>
  = note: required for the cast to the object type `dyn bevy::prelude::Reflect`
  = note: this error originates in a derive macro (in Nightly builds, run with -Z macro-backtrace for more info)
```

**Bevy version**
9239621f

**Operating system & version**

Arch Linux

**What you did**


This example demonstrates the error:
```
 use std::collections::HashMap;
 use bevy::prelude::*;
 use serde::{Serialize, Deserialize};

 fn main() {
     App::build().run();
 }

 #[derive(Default, Reflect)]
 struct ThingContainer {
     things: HashMap<Thing, u32>
 }

 #[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize, Reflect)]
 #[reflect_value(PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
 enum Thing {
     One,
     Two,
 }
```

**What you expected to happen**

I expect to be able to nest Reflect structs inside other Reflect structs, even if there's a collection involved.

**What actually happened**

Doesn't compile
